The northern cluster (Kispang, Kakani, Galchhi, Shivapuri) is cut off from the southern cluster, so car1 handles the north and car2 handles the south. Deferring the two Shivapuri elderly (100) and rescuing the Kakani adults (10 driving) is cheaper than the full round trip to Shivapuri (110 driving plus 100 deferral). In the south, the Syaphru elderly, the Jwalamukhi and Gajuri children, and the Myagang and Gajuri adults are rescued. The four Tarkeshwar adults are deferred, since the detour costs more than the penalty it avoids.
